en.headline: Golden Week day four passes 1.02 million crossings by 9pm
en.dek: The Immigration Department said more than 576,000 people had entered Hong Kong by 9pm on Sunday, with Lo Wu the busiest arrival point.
body: Crossings on the fourth day of the National Day Golden Week passed 1.02 million by 9pm on Sunday, the Immigration Department said, according to RTHK. Arrivals accounted for more than 576,000 of the total, and departures for more than 446,000.

Among people entering, more than 352,000 were Hong Kong residents and more than 198,000 were visitors from the mainland, the department said. Lo Wu recorded the most arrivals, followed by the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line control point.
On the way out, Hong Kong residents made more than 247,000 departures and mainland visitors nearly 170,000. Most departures were also through Lo Wu and the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line, RTHK reported.

By 4pm the same day the department had recorded about 616,000 crossings. Immigration had earlier forecast Sunday as the peak inbound day of the holiday, with about 586,000 arrivals expected at land control points.

zh.headline: 黃金周第四日截至晚上9時逾102萬人次出入境
zh.dek: 入境處表示，星期日截至晚上9時入境超過57萬6千人次，羅湖是入境最多人的管制站。
body: 香港電台引述入境處表示，國慶黃金周第四日截至星期日晚上9時，本港共錄得超過102萬人次出入境。其中入境超過57萬6千人次，出境超過44萬6千人次。
入境人士當中，本港居民超過35萬2千人次，內地訪客超過19萬8千人次。入境處指，整體最多人經羅湖口岸入境，其次是落馬洲支線管制站。
出境方面，本港居民佔24萬7千多人次，內地訪客亦有近17萬人次。港台報道，整體出境人士主要經羅湖口岸和落馬洲支線管制站。
同日截至下午4時，入境處錄得約61萬6千人次出入境。入境處早前預計星期日是假期陸路入境高峰，約58萬6千人次經陸路管制站入境。
